decisions.reason: The firm has shown the track spotlight on its own page for two consecutive years, and it sits squarely in its modular system offer, so the visible commitment and sunk investment favour keeping it.

The ceiling luminaire has been presented continuously since 2023 and is core to the established range, so dropping it would write off visible investment without any evidence that results can no longer be explained by temporary causes.
Launched only in 2024 with its own page, the flexible spotlight is too new for disappointing results to be judged permanent, and the firm has committed to it publicly.
The multi-outlet canopy extends the modular system concept the firm promotes as its strategic direction, which makes it central to its announced course and worth defending.
The low-voltage canopy builds on the system offer and has a dedicated page, so the investment in development and the public commitment favour persisting with it in its first full year.
With only a website mention, little public commitment and modest investment make this the easiest product to drop, but as a 2024 addition to the track range it is still likely to be given time.
